impact.text: A single participant (or the last remaining LP) cannot withdraw their shares; the call deterministically reverts with "ZW"

precondition_sources.text: The withdrawing user controls 100% of the outstanding gHYBR supply (e.g., the first depositor or the last remaining LP).
At withdraw time the user owns 100% of the contract's veNFT value.

intent_sources.text: A full withdrawal by a user controlling 100% of the outstanding gHYBR supply must not revert due to a zero remainder slice; the exit path must complete without a zero-valued multiSplit entry.
